Name: Malta Public Transport
Company description: MALTA PUBLIC TRANSPORT is the national bus operator responsible to operate all public transport services by bus on the Maltese islands. We form part of an international network of transport companies present on four continents with over 40,000 employees. With over 120 years of experience in efficient management of urban transport as well as regional, national and international bus, coach and rail transport, our philosophy is to maximize on this international experience and adapt it to the local context wherever we operate, including Malta.

Name: TheMillerGroup
Company description: The origins of the company date back to 1914, when specialisation was focused on the distribution of newspapers, magazines, and books - but has since expanded significantly, becoming one of Malta's most prominent distributors across multiple sectors. We are market leaders in our field with a 100-year success story in retail (both locally and internationally), logistics and wholesale distribution. A family-owned company with a strong reputation wherever we operate, we are professionally managed and run. Our success is the result of our commitment to attract and continuously train our fully committed, multi-disciplinary team. We invest heavily in our people who, like our customers, are ultimately the key to our success. We are proud of our team of over 400 incredible employees from 25 nationalities and growing.

Name: NorthStar Transloading
Company description: NorthStar Transloading is positioned and designed to support the growing need for rail transportation in and out of the Bakken region of North Dakota.  NorthStar Transloading is a 220+ acre state-of-the-art facility providing manifest and unit train switching and transloading via our BNSF served rail yard.

Name: SARDEGNA EXPRESS SHIPPING COMPANY
Company description: Sardegna Express presents and offers its maritime transport service to be allocated to public or private companies in the Sardinia Region and the Italian Continent that need maritime transport for their goods and finished products in and out to be transported. from the Continent to Sardinia and vice versa. The transfer of goods will be carried out by ship and by train in direct intermodal mode, with auxiliary support for road transport where explicitly requested. OUR ACTIVITIES Sardegna Express Ltd Shipping Company will carry out design diversifications on its maritime transport services by inserting different types of ships into its production system. In the commercial lines, naval units will be introduced for the transport of passengers and goods and ships suitable for the transport of railway wagons on board with flat or lowered side containment wagons for the transport of containerized goods of various types intended for the railway transport service Direct intermodal. The cargo ship (Cargo) will be used exclusively for the transport and recovery with relative delivery of the containers (empty containers) to the shippers or the owners of the empty in the ports of the Mediterranean Ionian Sea, Tyrrhenian Sea, Adriatic Sea Aegean Sea. Empty containers will be recovered where large container ships cannot dock in port or need to make up for sailing times. But at the same time Sardegna Express can guarantee direct line services in China. North America and South America with ships capable of carrying from 1400 to 2000 TEU with the possibility of multiple connections of refrigerant containers.  The maritime transport service offered will be and are operated according to the customer's needs on all European and intercontinental ports. Another new activity is destined to the cargo project for diversified loads on call or project for loads shared between different customers with the possibility of booking and shipping loads at the last minute.

Name: Virtu Holdings Limited
Company description: Virtu Holdings saw its origins as a ship owning company in 1945 operating cargo vessels between the Mediterranean and northern European ports. Currently the company’s core business is that of owners and operators of High Speed Passenger/Car Ferries on various routes, including Malta-Sicily and ports in the Adriatic. Other maritime services include bunkering and ship management. A number of other interests include real estate with a portfolio of commercial, industrial and residential properties in some of the island’s prime sites and a holding in one of Malta’s leading 5 Star Deluxe hotels.

Name: Malta Shipbrokers International Ltd
HQ Location: Malta, Vlt, 21/22 St Barbara Bastion Valletta Malta
Company description: Malta Shipbrokers International offer a one-stop solution for international shipbroker services. Specialising in RoRo, Ropax, Ferries and Fast Ferries. Our international network of contacts, years of experience and skilled team allows us to deliver superior service, sales and purchase assistance, ship evaluation, chartering, a one-stop solution for newbuilding, and consulting face to face law firms, banks and other financial organisations.

Name: John Ripard & Son Ltd
HQ Location: Malta, Il-belt Valletta, Valletta, 22 Lascaris Wharf
Company description: John Ripard & Son Ltd was established in Malta in 1901 acting as general passenger and cargo agent for Prince Line Ltd. During the 20th century we evolved as one of Malta's leading ship agents and in the mid 1970's, as agents for Manchester Liners, we were the first ship agent in Malta to introduce containerisation. Through investments, acquisitions, mergers and today is invested in ship agency, ship operating, container feedering, regional liner services, container m & r depot, worldwide forwarding, cruise liner husbanding, groupage & warehousing handling. The group is made up of a multitude of different companies but the essence of our success is belief and investment in our people, our information systems and our relentless focus on our customers.

Name: Rima Cruises
Company description: Rima Cruises Malta offers cruises & private tours along the South coast of Malta, giving our passengers the opportunity to see the magnificent coastlines from a different perspective.
